purpose: First realistic authored tree component family for Atlas species-driven structural variants and instanced desktop forests.

artDirection.summary: Believable broadleaf branching family: tapered trunk and connected limbs, irregular layered crown, thin shaped leaves, restrained bark relief and natural foliage transmission. Reference adult height 16 metres; species recipes define final dimensions.
artDirection.negativePrompt: solid faceted crown balls, disconnected floating branches, uniform repeated leaf fans, oversized leaves, baked directional lighting, cartoon saturation

visual: Branch hierarchy remains connected and tapers continuously at 1, 10 and 50 metres
Leaves have species-controlled physical dimensions rather than scaling with the whole crown
Eight bounded variants are recognizably related but differ in branch arrangement and crown silhouette
Bark and foliage respond coherently at midday, grazing sun and overcast light
technical: Metres, root-contact pivot, right-handed Y-up GLB, applied transforms, deterministic names and explicit UVs
LOD0 at most 18000 triangles, LOD1 at most 5000, LOD2 at most 900; silhouettes and root agree within 0.02 metres
Separate bark and foliage masks/tints; wind weights and conservative animation bounds are explicit
No baked light/shadow in base colour; exported roughness/normal/alpha are checked in the actual renderer
Source blend, recipe seed/version, mesh/material hashes and sidecar provenance are preserved
Assetctl technical validation, render sheet and export/import round trip pass
runtime: In-game fixed valley descent, rotation, date replay and near/mid transition show stable identity and dimensions
Report full-frame CPU/GPU percentiles, calls, triangles, texture/geometry memory and alpha overdraw at 1440p
Structural variant cache remains within an explicit byte budget; load and eviction cannot change instances
Desktop hardware floor remains to be selected; RTX 5090 evidence alone is not acceptance for midrange hardware

provenance.prompt: Author connected tapered wood and physically scaled broadleaf components for species-directed variants; preserve editable source and all export provenance.
provenance.negativePrompt: floating limbs, opaque crown blobs, baked sun lighting

restrictions: Prototype assets require visual, LOD, provenance and runtime acceptance before packaging or shipping

provenance.notes: Original procedural mesh and texture proposals have been authored through the named operation and reviewed. No external mesh, photograph or learned generator input is used. This brief does not assert a finished asset, resolved output license or a runtime budget pass.

experiments.selectionMetric: Connected silhouette, physical leaf scale, LOD consistency, alpha overdraw, full-scene timing and cleanup cost
